seoTitle: The Simpsons Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Simpsons test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, Grampa, Mr. Burns, Ned, Moe or Milhouse — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the donut-loving dad, the brilliant saxophonist, or the neighbour who's way too nice? Answer 12 everyday questions about work, family and Monday mornings, and find out which Simpsons character you are.

characters.name: Homer Simpson
characters.title: The Dad
characters.summary: Easygoing, impulsive and big-hearted. You love food, naps and your family, not always in that order.
description: Like Homer, you know how to relax. He's lazy, impulsive and especially fond of donuts.
You're not always qualified, but you show up. Homer is the safety inspector at the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant.
You'd do anything for your family. Underneath it all, Homer is kind-hearted and fiercely protective of the people he loves.
characters.flaw: You act on impulse, then say "D'oh!" when it goes wrong.
characters.signature: A donut, the couch and a big hug for your family.
characters.clashReason: they'd eat your lunch, then forget they ever did

characters.name: Marge Simpson
characters.title: The Rock
characters.summary: Kind, patient and the one who holds it all together. You keep everyone grounded, even when they drive you up the wall.
description: Like Marge, you hold everything together. She's the family's kind-hearted, moral voice.
You're patient. Very, very patient. Marge is Homer's long-suffering wife.
You've got a look all your own. Marge is known for her tall blue beehive hair.
characters.flaw: You worry about everyone, all the time.
characters.signature: A packed lunch, a patient sigh and a very tall hairdo.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you a disappointed look you'd never forget

characters.name: Bart Simpson
characters.title: The Troublemaker
characters.summary: Cheeky, fearless and always up to something. You'd rather have fun than follow the rules, and you usually get away with it.
description: Like Bart, you love a bit of mischief. He's the Simpsons' oldest child, and he sees himself as a bad boy.
You can't resist a prank. Bart is always pulling one on somebody.
You've got a favourite target. Bart keeps prank-calling Moe's Tavern with fake names.
characters.flaw: You'd rather cause trouble than do your homework.
characters.signature: A cheeky grin, a phone and a prank already in motion.
characters.clashReason: they'd prank you, then deny everything

characters.name: Lisa Simpson
characters.title: The Brain
characters.summary: Brilliant, principled and passionate about making the world better. You're often the smartest person in the room, and you know it.
description: Like Lisa, you're brilliant. She's eight years old with an IQ of 159, and she joins Springfield's chapter of Mensa.
You stand by your principles. Lisa is passionate about the environment and social causes, and she's been a vegetarian since season 7.
You've got soul. Lisa plays the baritone saxophone, and jazz is her favourite music.
characters.flaw: You can be a little self-righteous about being right.
characters.signature: A saxophone, a stack of books and a cause to fight for.
characters.clashReason: they'd explain, at length, exactly why you're wrong

characters.name: Grampa Simpson
characters.title: The Storyteller
characters.summary: Cranky, stubborn and full of stories. You've seen it all, and you'll tell anyone who'll listen, and plenty who won't.
description: Like Grampa, you've got a story for everything. He tells long, winding tales that often go nowhere.
You've lived a life. Grampa is a World War II veteran who served with the Flying Hellfish.
You say what you think, even when nobody's listening. Grampa is famously cranky, and often ignored by his family.
characters.flaw: You complain about everything new, and tell the same story twice.
characters.signature: A long story, a comfy chair and strong opinions about the old days.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you a story that never, ever ends

characters.name: Mr. Burns
characters.title: The Tycoon
characters.summary: Ambitious, ruthless and very, very rich. You like being in charge, and you're not too worried about who gets hurt along the way.
description: Like Mr. Burns, you're the boss. He owns the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant, and he's the richest man in town.
You don't do names. Mr. Burns keeps forgetting who his employees are, including Homer.
You've got a signature move. Mr. Burns steeples his fingers, and slowly says, "Excellent..."
characters.flaw: You care about money a lot more than people.
characters.signature: Steepled fingers, a sinister smile and a very large bank account.
characters.clashReason: they'd forget your name, then cut your pay

characters.name: Ned Flanders
characters.title: The Good Neighbour
characters.summary: Cheerful, generous and relentlessly nice. You're always ready to help, even when people don't quite know what to do with you.
description: Like Ned, you're nice. Really, really nice. He's the Simpsons' next-door neighbour, and a devout churchgoer.
You've found your niche. Ned runs the Leftorium, a shop for left-handed people.
You're always ready to help. Ned later becomes Bart's teacher.
characters.flaw: You're so nice that it drives people a little bit mad.
characters.signature: A big moustache, a cheerful wave and a hand always ready to help.
characters.clashReason: they'd be so nice that you'd feel bad for being grumpy

characters.name: Moe Szyslak
characters.title: The Grump
characters.summary: Blunt, grumpy and secretly soft. You expect the worst, but there's a good heart under all that grumbling.
description: Like Moe, you don't sugar-coat things. He owns Moe's Tavern, and he's short-tempered, stingy and blunt.
You fall for it every time. Moe keeps answering Bart's prank calls, and gets furious every single time.
You've got a softer side. Moe reads to sick children.
characters.flaw: You expect the worst, and you're usually grumpy about it.
characters.signature: A grumpy face, a short temper and a soft heart nobody sees.
characters.clashReason: they'd snap at you, then feel bad about it later

characters.name: Milhouse Van Houten
characters.title: The Sidekick
characters.summary: Loyal, hopeful and a little bit anxious. You'd follow your best friend anywhere, even when you know it's a bad idea.
description: Like Milhouse, you're loyal. He's Bart's best friend.
You trust people, maybe a bit too much. Bart often drags Milhouse into trouble.
You never stop hoping. Milhouse has a long-running crush on Lisa.
characters.flaw: You get talked into things far too easily.
characters.signature: Thick glasses, a nervous laugh and a best friend who's always getting you into trouble.
characters.clashReason: they'd follow you everywhere, then blame you when it went wrong

questions.text: Your alarm goes off on a Monday morning. You...

options.text: Hit snooze. Then hit it again. Then call in sick
Get up straight away, and start making everyone's lunch
Leap out of bed, ready to make it a wonderful day
Turn it off. You've been awake since 4am anyway

questions.text: You've got a big assignment due tomorrow. You...

options.text: Finished it last week, and did the extra credit
Come up with a brilliant excuse instead
Copy your best friend's, and hope you don't get caught
Start it, then fall asleep halfway through

questions.text: A lazy Sunday, done your way, looks like...

options.text: Donuts, the couch and absolutely nothing else
A jazz record and a stack of books
Church, then a big barbecue for the neighbours
A quiet day at work, grumbling to anyone who'll listen

questions.text: A friend asks to borrow cash. Again. You...

options.text: Offer it, at a ruinous interest rate
Give it to them, and tell them not to worry about paying it back
Lend it, then remind them about it every day
Help them, then quietly worry about it for weeks

questions.text: A new rule at work makes no sense. You...

options.text: Write a strongly worded letter, and start a petition
Find a way to break it, just to see what happens
Complain that things were better in your day
Follow it, nervously, in case you get in trouble

questions.text: Someone at a party is telling a very long story. You...

options.text: Interrupt with an even longer story of your own
Listen politely, even though it's dull
Pull faces behind their back
Forget their name before they've even finished

questions.text: You get a big promotion. You...

options.text: Take all the credit, and none of the blame
Celebrate with a huge meal, then forget what the job actually is
Hope they finally take you seriously
Panic. Everyone's going to find out you have no idea what you're doing

questions.text: Your crush doesn't seem to notice you. You...

options.text: Keep trying. One day they'll notice
Assume it's because of your face, and sulk
Pull a prank to get their attention
Wait patiently. Good things take time

questions.text: Your neighbour keeps borrowing your things. You...

options.text: Let them. That's what neighbours are for
Borrow some of theirs back, and never return it
Sue them
Yell at them about it from your porch

questions.text: Your family plans a holiday. You...

options.text: Plan every detail, and pack snacks for everyone
Count down the days until you can cause chaos somewhere new
Research the history of where you're going
Ask if you really have to come

questions.text: You own the town's power plant, and the town wants you to pay for safety upgrades. You...

options.text: Refuse. Safety is expensive
Switch to clean energy while you're at it
Do it, once someone explains what a safety upgrade is
Pay up straight away. It's the right thing to do

questions.text: You're a kid, and you've been sent to the principal's office again. You...

options.text: Wave hello. You practically have your own chair in there
Blame your best friend
Feel terrible, and apologise to everyone
Threaten to fight anyone who laughs
